verdict.rationale: Pinecone's docs say its in-memory local emulator, Pinecone Local, reached end of life on October 7, 2026. The documented replacement is a Prism mock of the API built from the OpenAPI specs, and it does not support write-then-read or real search, so it is not a local database instance. No evidence shows an embedded in-process mode or a lightweight local instance for small workloads.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the database embedded in-process or as a lightweight local instance for development and small workloads
